_doc: Category strikes made before freezing. A struck domain can't be selected for that industry; the selector's walk continues to the next candidate by the same rule, so the replacement is never hand-picked. Criterion: the organization's main business is outside that industry's definition in methodology.md §1. 'requested_by' records who asked for the strike.
